chapterInfo.content:
11
Nyankopɔn mmɔborɔhunu
1 # Eks 4.22; Mat 2.15 Israel yɛ aberanteɛ no, na medɔ no,
na Misraim na mefrɛɛ me ba firiiɛ.
2Berɛ dodoɔ a mefrɛɛ wɔn no,
dodoɔ no ara na wɔfirii m’anim kɔeɛ;
wɔkɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ maa Baal ahodoɔ,
na wɔhyee aduhwam maa ahoni.
3Nso me na megyegyee Efraim taataa;
meturuu wɔn m’abasa so,
na wɔanhunu sɛ masa wɔn yadeɛ.
4Nnipa nhoma na mede metwee wɔn,
ne ɔdɔ ntampehoma nso,
na meyɛɛ wɔn sɛ deɛ
ɔmema kɔnnua soɔ wɔ wɔn nnyepi so,
na meyɛɛ no brɛɛ memaa no didii.
5Ɔbɛsane n’akyiri akɔ Misraim asase so bio,
na Asiria na ɔyɛ ne hene,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔampene sɛ wɔsane wɔn akyire ba me nkyɛn.
6Na wɔn agyinatuo ahodoɔ no nti
afena bɛkyinkyini ne nkuro mu,
na ɛbɛsɛe n’apono akyiri adaban awie.
7Me so atuateɛ nko ara na me man de asi wɔn anim,
na wɔfrɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnhwɛ soro a,
wɔn mu biara mmua me mpo.
8 # Deut 29.23; Yer 31.20 Anka mɛyi wo mama sɛn, O Efraim,
na magyaa wo mu sɛn, O Israel!
Adɛn nti na mɛyi wo mama sɛ Adma,
na mayɛ wo sɛ Seboim?
M’akoma adane wɔ me mu, aane!
mmɔborɔhunu agye me yam nyinaa.
9 # Kwa 3.31-36 Merenni m’abufuhyeɛ no so,
merensane memmɛsɛe Efraim;
na Onyankopɔn ne me, na ɛnyɛ onipa,
wo mu kronkronni ne me,
na meremma abohuro so.
10 # Yes 31.4-5; Yer 25.30; Hos 1.10 Wɔbɛdi AWURADE
a ɔbɛbobom sɛ gyata akyi,
ampa ara ɔbɛbobom,
na mma de ahopopoɔ afiri po akyiri aba.
11Wɔde ahopere bɛfiri Misraim aba sɛ nnomaa,
na wɔafiri Asiria asase so aba sɛ mmuruburo,
na mede wɔn madua wɔn afie mu, AWURADE asɛm nie.
12Efraim de atorɔ
na Israel fie de nsisie atwa me ho ahyia,
nanso Yuda deɛ ɔbɔ Onyankopɔn,
Ɔkronkronni ne Nokwafoɔ no ho kɔntɔnkrɔn.

Israel yɛ aberanteɛ no, na medɔ no,
na Misraim na mefrɛɛ me ba firiiɛ.
Berɛ dodoɔ a mefrɛɛ wɔn no,
dodoɔ no ara na wɔfirii m’anim kɔeɛ;
wɔkɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ maa Baal ahodoɔ,
na wɔhyee aduhwam maa ahoni.
Nso me na megyegyee Efraim taataa;

na wɔanhunu sɛ masa wɔn yadeɛ.
Nnipa nhoma na mede metwee wɔn,
ne ɔdɔ ntampehoma nso,
na meyɛɛ wɔn sɛ deɛ
ɔmema kɔnnua soɔ wɔ wɔn nnyepi so,
na meyɛɛ no brɛɛ memaa no didii.

Na wɔn agyinatuo ahodoɔ no nti
afena bɛkyinkyini ne nkuro mu,
na ɛbɛsɛe n’apono akyiri adaban awie.
Me so atuateɛ nko ara na me man de asi wɔn anim,
na wɔfrɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnhwɛ soro a,
wɔn mu biara mmua me mpo.
Anka mɛyi wo mama sɛn, O Efraim,

Adɛn nti na mɛyi wo mama sɛ Adma,

mmɔborɔhunu agye me yam nyinaa.
Merenni m’abufuhyeɛ no so,

Wɔbɛdi AWURADE

Wɔde ahopere bɛfiri Misraim aba sɛ nnomaa,

Efraim de atorɔ

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
